newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BRL plans vineyard operation near Canberra.
newsitem.headline: BRL plans vineyard operation near Canberra.

text.p: Independent wine producer BRL Hardy Ltd said on Thursday that it would establish vineyard and tourism operations near the national capital of Canberra, with plans for output of 200,000 cases of wine within six years.
The company said it had signed a statement of intent with the Australian Capital Territory government to initially establish between 100 and 150 hectares of vineyards.
This would be the base for a new winery, cellar door sales, and tourism facility which would be opened by early 1999.

BRL said the next stage of the operation would involve the planting of a further 100 hectares and the construction of a 2,000 tonne vintage processing facility within three years of planting the vineyards.
Managing director Stephen Millar told Reuters that the project would cost about A$10 million but would not comment on projected sales and earnings.
Millar said the company currently took about 130 tonnes from the Canberra region.
